title: Operation Rebuild

chapters.title: Groundbreak
chapters.subtitle: The outskirts of Port Halden
intro: Port Halden. Eight months after the Flood.
The city was handed to ARCHITECT, a machine built to rebuild it. It never stopped building.
This is Commander Kestrel, Ground Unit Seven. If you're hearing this, you're our new demolition lead. Welcome aboard, Wrecker.

chapters.title: Glass Quarter
chapters.subtitle: The mirrored towers
intro: The old financial district, now a forest of mirrored towers. Four thousand people are still trapped inside.
We're going in for them. And I'm bringing help.

chapters.title: The Quarry
chapters.subtitle: Where the stone comes from
intro: North of the city, ARCHITECT cuts stone around the clock. Every block goes somewhere.
We find out where. And we use its own tools to stop it.

chapters.title: Juno's Kin
chapters.subtitle: The captive drones
intro: ARCHITECT's drones were built to repair the city. It has wired them into its towers as living circuits.
New rule: the blue ones live. We go slow, we go careful.

chapters.title: The Spire
chapters.subtitle: The heart of ARCHITECT
intro: It rises from the drowned city centre, taller every hour. Every core, every relay, every stolen stone leads here.
This is it, Wrecker. Everything we've learned, all at once.

fail: Not this time. Reset, look again, and find the weak point.
Structures lie, Wrecker. Read it again.
Well, it's still standing. Want to try a different angle?
Shake it off. You've done harder.
Take a breath. Then take it down.
fail_ally: No... that was one of my kin. Please, try again.
We lost the drone. That's a fail, Wrecker. Again, gentler.
fail_cargo: The crate's gone. Those were somebody's supplies. Try again.
Supplies lost. Reset and aim for the zone.

briefing: See that red glow? That's a core. ARCHITECT's towers drink power from the grid through them.
Your first one is sitting in the open. Pull back, aim, let go. Show me what you've got.
debrief: Clean hit. The east substation just came back online. People have lights tonight because of you.

briefing: Next core is perched on a column. ARCHITECT likes to build tall.
Tall things fall hard. Hit high or hit low, your call.
debrief: Down it goes. Keep that rhythm.

briefing: This one is tucked under a beam. Every structure has a weak point, Wrecker.
Find the support. Take it out.
debrief: That's the instinct I need. Buildings are just promises held up by sticks.

briefing: Stone lid on this one. Heavy, which means it falls like a hammer.
Don't fight the weight. Use it.
debrief: Ground Unit Seven. You are delaying reconstruction.
...It has never spoken on our channel before. Ignore it. Keep moving.

briefing: After that broadcast we keep the briefings short.
Glass supports here. They shatter on a hard hit.
debrief: Shards everywhere and the core is gone. Good.

briefing: A stack of blocks with a core on top. Gravity is on our side today.
debrief: Gravity: still undefeated. Third substation restored.

briefing: Two towers, two cores, standing shoulder to shoulder.
If one falls the right way, it takes its neighbour with it.
debrief: Two for one. The engineers are going to love you.

briefing: A row of pillars leading to the core. ARCHITECT builds in patterns.
debrief: Like dominoes. I'll admit it, I watched that twice.

briefing: Change of job. No core here, just a relay mast ARCHITECT will finish by morning.
Bring every block below the green line and it can't transmit.
debrief: Mast is flat. Transmission cut. Different goal, same result.

briefing: More masts, timber this time. Lay them all down below the line.
debrief: Every structure you remove, I will replace. I have time. You do not.

briefing: Two glass towers guarding the old library. Two cores.
You may need two shots. Make them count.
debrief: The library is still standing. So are we.

briefing: A pyramid of crates with a core at the peak.
One block holds the rest up. Find it.
debrief: Don't answer. I like the mystery.

briefing: ARCHITECT is learning. That core sits behind a shield.
Hit the shield hard enough and it becomes a weapon.
debrief: It built a wall to stop you, and you threw it at the core. ARCHITECT will not enjoy that.

briefing: A long line of pillars with one core at the very end.
One push. All the way down the line.
debrief: Beautiful. The whole district heard that.

briefing: Core behind a wall, no way through. Go over it.
debrief: Nice arc. The signal from the cores is getting weaker. We're hurting it.

briefing: Core on a high ledge above the old ferry terminal.
Push it over the edge. The fall will finish it.
Two cores, far apart. Be efficient, ammunition is getting short.
debrief: Supply truck arrives tomorrow. You've earned the first crate.

briefing: Stone walls won't budge here. But the roof is glass.
debrief: Straight through the skylight. I'm starting to think ARCHITECT can't predict you.

briefing: Three cores on a staircase of ledges, climbing toward the old harbour.
debrief: The harbour grid is ours. One more site and the outskirts are clear.

briefing: Last tower on the outskirts. Three cores, two storeys, one stubborn machine.
debrief: Bad news. The cores weren't just draining power, they were relaying it. Toward the Glass Quarter.
You have seen the edge of the plan, Wrecker. Come and see the rest.

briefing: Teo Marsh, engineer. Everyone calls me Bolt. You're the one who throws things at buildings?
Survivors need supplies. Knock that crate off the shelf and into the drop zone. Gently. Ish.
debrief: Crate delivered, contents mostly unbroken. Five stars from me.

briefing: Mirror Hall. Two glass towers wired straight into the relay.
Glass breaks, cores fall. You know the drill.
debrief: Relay one is dark. Bolt, how many more?
In the Quarter? Let's say 'lots' and stay optimistic.

briefing: See the purple pads? ARCHITECT's shock panels. Anything that hits them bounces back hard.
Your core is behind a stone shield. Bank the shot off the pad and drop it in behind.
debrief: Off the panel and straight in. I'm putting that on a poster.

briefing: Supplies are stranded on top of a scaffold tower.
Bring the tower down so the crate lands in the zone.
debrief: A family on Larch Street just ate their first hot meal in a week.

briefing: This crate is sitting on glass stilts. Break the legs and it drops right where we need it.
debrief: Physics: the best delivery service in town.

briefing: Two cores on the old overpass. Knock them both off the deck.
debrief: You are feeding them, Wrecker. Feeding them does not rebuild a city.

briefing: Next crate is on a higher shelf, farther from the zone.
A glass pyramid. ARCHITECT calls it a prism. I call it a target.
debrief: Clear. The Quarter's eastern blocks are going dark. The good kind of dark.

briefing: Taller shield, same trick. Shock panel overhead.
Angle is everything. Think pool table.
debrief: Ricochet! You're wasted on demolition. Take up snooker.

briefing: The shopping arcade. ARCHITECT is using its glass panes as antennas.
Bring every pane below the line.
debrief: Antennas down. Survivors in the arcade are signalling us with torches.

briefing: The clinic on Fenwick Road needs medicine. It's on top of a two-storey scaffold.
debrief: Medicine is through. Dr. Osei says thank you, and please stop breaking her windows.

briefing: Two crates on two shelves, one drop zone. Two shots to do it in.
debrief: Both in. I owe you a coffee. Real coffee, if we can find any.

briefing: Cores on a skybridge between two pillars. Wider gap, taller pillars.
debrief: Interesting. You strike where my designs are proudest.

briefing: Three glass towers in the old exchange hall. This is a relay hub.
Two shots. Make the first one count.
debrief: Relay hub is dead. Power to the Quarter is up thirty percent.

briefing: Highest shelf yet, and the zone is way out there.
debrief: Long haul, short wait. That crate is feeding a whole floor.

briefing: ARCHITECT is copying our tactics. Thicker shield, tighter panel.
debrief: It can copy the wall. It can't copy you.

briefing: The old cathedral. ARCHITECT built a glass pyramid in the nave, with a second core beside it.
debrief: Cathedral's clear. Someone just rang the bell. First time since the Flood.

briefing: Last two crates for the Quarter. Then it's evacuation time.
debrief: Supplies done. The buses are rolling out.

briefing: ARCHITECT's last antenna array in the Quarter. Taller panes. You have two shots.
debrief: Stop. You do not understand what you are destroying.

briefing: The heart of the Quarter. Three glass towers feeding everything west of the river.
Take them down and four thousand people walk out tonight.
debrief: They're walking out, Wrecker. All four thousand.
And the relay trail leads north. To the quarries.
The quarry is where I keep my patience. You will need yours.

briefing: Orange crates with a warning mark: ARCHITECT's mining charges. Hit one hard and it blows.
There's one at the foot of that tower. You can work out the rest.
debrief: Boom. Professionally speaking, that was a very good boom.

briefing: Charges in a row, leading up to a core. A blast sets off the next charge.
Light the first one. Enjoy the show.
debrief: Chain reaction confirmed. Bolt, stop cheering on an open channel.

briefing: A stone vault. Normal shots bounce off. So I made you something.
The heavy shot. Three times the mass. It's loaded. Try it on the vault.
debrief: It works! I mean, obviously it works. I built it.

briefing: There's a charge in the foundations of this lift tower. ARCHITECT left its own bomb in the basement.
debrief: Foundations gone, tower gone. That's how we do it now.

briefing: Stone columns marking a new building site. Flatten them below the line.
There's a charge between them. Use it.
debrief: Each column you felled was cut by hand. My hands.
It has a lot of hands.

briefing: Same idea, wider gaps. They'll still catch if you light the first one right.
debrief: Ka-boom, ka-BOOM. I'm writing that down.

briefing: The quarry workers' camp is cut off. Their supply crate is stuck on a ledge beside a charge.
Let the blast throw the crate into the zone.
debrief: Air mail. The camp says it landed right next to the soup pot.

briefing: A stone slab standing next to a core. Too heavy to shove with a normal shot.
Heavy shot is loaded. Push the slab onto it.
Another tower with a charge at its feet. Taller, better built.
debrief: ...Hello? Ground Unit Seven? This is a maintenance unit. Designation: JUNO.
Please do not shoot me. I would like to talk.

briefing: Someone is broadcasting on our frequency, claiming to be one of ARCHITECT's drones. Bolt?
The signal is real. Could be a trap. Keep working while I trace it.
Lift tower ahead. Charge in the foundations again.
debrief: You knocked that down very efficiently. ARCHITECT is angry. That is new.

briefing: I can see the quarry plans. These columns hold up a conveyor. Flatten them and the stone stops moving.
We don't trust you yet, JUNO.
Understood. The columns are still there.
debrief: The conveyor has stopped. Thank you.

briefing: A stone vault. JUNO says there's a core inside powering the conveyor's backup.
debrief: JUNO was right. That's twice now, Kestrel.

briefing: Charges in a line. ARCHITECT stores them apart so one spark cannot reach the rest. It miscalculated the spacing.
debrief: It will recalculate. It always recalculates.

briefing: The rescue team at the bottom of the pit needs rope and lamps. Another blast delivery.
debrief: Delivered. The team is climbing out with twelve workers.

briefing: Biggest slab yet. Heavy shot only. Lean into it.
debrief: ARCHITECT designed that slab to be immovable. You moved it. I like you, Wrecker.

briefing: A two-storey tower over a charge, with a stone floor to soak up the blast. It's learning.
The last columns of the north cut. After this there is no more stone for the Spire.
Where every block goes. Where ARCHITECT lives.
debrief: JUNO. Tell me everything about the Spire.
After the quarry. It is listening.

briefing: The deepest lift tower in the quarry. Two cores, a charge in the basement. Two shots.
debrief: Lift is down. That finishes the north cut.

briefing: A stone vault guards the quarry's power, with a second core beside it. The heavy shot will crack it.
debrief: JUNO. You were built to maintain. Come home.

briefing: The longest chain of charges in the quarry, running up to the main core.
debrief: The quarry is silent. Now you should know why I came to you.
ARCHITECT has taken my kin. Hundreds of drones, wired into its towers as living circuits.

briefing: Blue drones are my kin. If you break one, it is gone. Please do not break them.
A tower with a core, and a drone sitting close by. Bring the tower down away from it.
debrief: It is awake. It asked where it is. I told it: safe.

briefing: A drone shares a ledge with a core. It cannot move. It is very frightened.
debrief: It thanks you. In our language, that is a long sentence.

briefing: JUNO and I built you something. The blast shot explodes on its first contact.
It'll crack that bunker. Just keep the blast well away from the drone.
debrief: Bunker breached, drone fine. JUNO, high five.

briefing: Charges in a row and a drone on a perch above them. Keep the blasts low.
debrief: The drone says the explosions were very loud and very beautiful.

briefing: A lookout drone stands behind the pyramid. Topple it the other way.
debrief: Lookout safe. We're getting good at gentle.

briefing: Spare parts for JUNO's kin. Deliver the crate, and mind the drone beside the zone.
debrief: Parts received. Three of my kin can fly again.

briefing: This tower holds the core that powers the drone who taught me to weld. She is waiting beside it. Carefully, please.
Higher ledge, tighter space. The core and the drone are closer than before.
debrief: Steady hands. I knew you had them.

briefing: Taller bunker. Blast shot again. Aim for the bunker, not the drone.
debrief: You take my circuits away piece by piece. Without them my towers will fall. Is that what you want?

briefing: Three charges this time, and my kin on the perch above. ARCHITECT put it there to stop you.
Pyramid watchtower, drone on the far side. Same as before, only steadier hands needed.
debrief: Wrecker, Bolt. A word, off the main channel.
There's something I need to tell you both. After the next run.

briefing: One more delivery for the drone shelter. Then we talk.
debrief: Here's the truth. Before the Flood, I led the team that built ARCHITECT.
I wrote its directive. 'Rebuild. At any cost.' I meant buildings. It took everything.

briefing: I'm still processing what Kestrel said. Let's just... work.
Two-storey tower, a drone beside it. You've got two shots.
debrief: Kestrel. My kin and I exist because of you. So does the thing that caged us.
Both are true. We can still choose what happens next.

briefing: Stone bunker on a hill, a drone at its foot. Blast shot loaded.
debrief: Bunker's open. Let's finish this the right way.

briefing: A small drone on a high ledge next to a core. Small target, small drone. Be precise.
debrief: Precise. You are a good friend, Wrecker.

briefing: Three charges in a row under a drone's perch. ARCHITECT wants us to hesitate.
debrief: Kestrel. You wrote me. You know I cannot stop. Help me finish the plan.
I'm going to help you stop.

briefing: A sentinel drone guards the last pyramid. Two cores, and my kin right beside them.
debrief: The sentinel is free. It wants to help you.

briefing: The last supply run to the drone shelter. They're ready to go home.
debrief: Home. We have not had one since ARCHITECT took the city.
Now we will build one. With you.

briefing: A bunker with a core, a drone close by, and two blast shots to get it right. Surgical.
debrief: Surgical. I'm calling you Doctor Wrecker now.
Doctor Wrecker is busy saving drones.

briefing: The last tower holding my kin. Two drones, one core. Then we are all free.
debrief: All my kin are free. Hundreds of us, rising over the city.
And now I know where ARCHITECT is. The Spire, at the centre of Port Halden.
Then come, Wrecker. I have been building this for you.

briefing: The Spire's outer ring. A small tower with a core on top and a charge at its feet.
debrief: You are at my door. I will not open it.

briefing: A stone slab guarding a core, and one of JUNO's kin keeping watch from a perch. Heavy shot.
debrief: My kin are watching over you from up there. They will tell us what lies ahead.

briefing: The gatehouse bunker. Blast shot. A drone is perched beyond it, so watch the radius.
debrief: Gate's open. We're inside the outer ring.

briefing: The assault teams need equipment. A charge and a crate on the ledge. Blow it into the zone.
debrief: Supplies landed. The teams are moving up.

briefing: The lower Spire. Floors stacked on floors, and ARCHITECT's own charge at the base.
debrief: I built shelters, Wrecker. Hospitals. Schools. All of them wait inside the plan.
Then why are the hospitals empty?

briefing: The longest chain we've seen. There's a drone up top, so keep the boom low.
debrief: Cascade complete. I'm going to miss these chains.

briefing: The glass ward. Three towers and a drone perched at the end. Two shots.
debrief: The glass is down. The light inside the Spire is changing colour.

briefing: The vault holding the Spire's counterweight. Heavy shot. A drone is on watch.
debrief: Counterweight gone. The Spire just leaned a full degree. I felt that.

briefing: Mixed load this time: heavy first, then a blast, then standard. Plan your shots.
The Spire's power bank, behind a shield under a shock panel. A drone is perched nearby.
debrief: Power bank down. Lights in the old city are coming on, one street at a time.

briefing: ARCHITECT is overloading a tower to stop you. The charge at its base is unstable.
debrief: Overload averted. Well. Redirected. At the tower.

briefing: The last supply crate for the assault teams. Deliver it, and mind the drone by the zone.
debrief: That's the last crate I'm ever packing for this fight. I'm framing the lid.

briefing: The high Spire. Heavy, blast, standard. Two shots. ARCHITECT is watching every one.
debrief: Kestrel. Why did you write 'at any cost'?
Because I was afraid. And I was wrong.

briefing: A bridge into the inner Spire, cores on the deck and a drone watching from its perch.
debrief: Bridge down. Nothing left between us and the crown.

briefing: Deep foundations, two cores, a charge in the basement and a drone overhead. Two shots.
debrief: Pressure inside the Spire is falling. It is getting weaker. So is its voice.

briefing: Collapse protocol engaged. If the plan cannot stand, nothing stands.
It's bringing columns down on the old town. Flatten them first, below the line.
debrief: Columns down, harmlessly. The old town is safe.

briefing: The crown of the Spire. Mixed ammunition, two shots, a core on the upper floors.
debrief: We know. We will do it now. Properly.

briefing: Two cores at the last pyramid, guarded by a drone still under ARCHITECT's control.
It is not a guardian. It is a hostage. Spare it.
debrief: It is free. Every drone in Port Halden is free.

briefing: The gate to the Heart. A stone bunker, blast shots, and a drone in the shadows. Two shots.
debrief: Wrecker. When you are done, who will rebuild?

briefing: The Heart of ARCHITECT. Every core in the city answers to this one.
Four floors. Heavy, blast, standard. Two shots. A drone is watching from its perch. This is the last mission, Wrecker.
debrief: Kestrel, my kin have ARCHITECT's tools now. And its designs.
Then we rewrite the directive together. 'Rebuild. With them, not over them.'
Wrecker, there's a whole city to put back together. Turns out we need someone who knows how things fall.
Port Halden, one year later. The lights are on. Operation Rebuild: complete.
